man.relayd:
RELAYD(8)            MRA/UX Manager's Manual

NAME
    relayd - key the relay's transmitters to its schedule

SYNOPSIS
    relayd [-s schedule] [-l log]

DESCRIPTION
    relayd keys the transmitters as the schedule says
    (/etc/relay/schedule; during the trial, the technician's
    copy). Every carrier is logged to /var/log/messages.
    A carrier relayd did not key is logged as unscheduled.

FILES
    /etc/relay/schedule   /var/log/messages   /var/spool/relay
